rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a borderland or border region between countries or territories.

example.english: This river is the frontier between the two countries.
example.traditional: 呢條河係兩個國家嘅邊境。
example.jyutping: nei1 tiu4 ho4 hai6 loeng5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 bin1 ging2
